en.summary: Smoke test data only: a pretend rocket jumper that never existed, written purely to exercise the publish pipeline end to end.
en.description: Smoke test data only. This pretend game exists solely to verify the PlayTrail publishing pipeline: gates, revisions, and the public read model. It describes a fictional rocket-powered jumper across a procedurally generated skyline, with absolutely no real game behind it.
en.controls:
WASD: move
Space: jump
Mouse: aim

zh.summary: 冒烟测试数据：一款并不存在的虚构火箭跳跃游戏，仅用于验证发布流程。
zh.description: 冒烟测试数据。这款虚构游戏唯一存在的目的是验证 PlayTrail 的发布流程：发布门禁、修订版本与公开读模型。内容描述了一个跨越程序生成天际线的火箭跳跃角色，背后没有任何真实游戏。
zh.controls:
WASD：移动
空格：跳跃
鼠标：瞄准

en.summary: Smoke test data: an imaginary idle farm with a hundred fictional crops, used only to seed the local development database.
en.description: Smoke test data only. This imaginary idle farming game exists to exercise category counts, related-game scoring, and the locale-level publish gates. Nothing about it corresponds to any real product.

zh.summary: 冒烟测试数据：一座虚构的放置农场，用于填充本地开发数据库。
zh.description: 冒烟测试数据。这款虚构的放置农场游戏用于验证分类计数、相关游戏评分与按语言的发布门禁，与任何真实产品无关。

en.summary: Smoke test data: a fictional racer that stays a draft and must never appear on any public surface.
en.description: Smoke test data only. This fictional racing game intentionally remains a draft so the E2E suite can assert that drafts never leak into public lists, sitemaps, or detail pages.
